# Library App

- kind: desktop

## Find a book

1. Search [form]: Sees the search box. Enters a title.
2. Results [list]: Sees matching titles.

## Reserve a book

1. Book details [detail]: Sees the book and its availability. Taps "Reserve".
2. Reserved [done]: Sees the pickup date.

## Renew a loan

1. Current loans [list]: Sees books still on loan. Taps "Renew".
2. Renewed [done]: Sees the new due date.

## Return a book

1. Scan a book [form]: Sees the return scanner. Scans the book's barcode.
2. Returned [done]: Sees the return confirmation.

## View receipts

1. Account [grid]: Sees account options. Opens receipts.
2. Receipts [list]: Sees past loans and returns.
